links.outcome: AI intra-examiner reproducibility of MCI classification across two sessions at least two weeks apart
links.effect: Intra-examiner reliability of the AI was exceptionally high (κ = 0.987).
links.quote: The intra-examiner reliability of the AI was exceptionally high (κ = 0.987).

links.outcome: Agreement of generative AI MCI classification with dentists on panoramic radiographs
links.effect: AI-dentist agreement was slight or lower (κ < 0.2) for every pairing, with 95% CIs including zero; two-level discrepancy (Class 1 vs Class 3) in 10-18% of cases.
links.quote: However, agreement between the AI and the dentists remained at "slight agreement" or lower (κ < 0.2) for every pairing, with 95% confidence intervals that included zero; no formal global hypothesis test was performed, and these individual interval estimates should not be interpreted as proof of the absence of agreement beyond chance.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the reproducibility and inter-rater agreement of a generative AI tool (NotebookLM) compared to dentists on an image classification task (mandibular cortical index on radiographs) without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
